title: Alert Configuration
content: This is the Alert Configuration page. Here you can set KPI thresholds and notification rules for every container across all branches.

title: Open Alert Configuration
content: Click here to navigate to the Alert Configuration page.

title: Branch Filters
content: Use the branch filter to narrow the container list to a specific location. This makes it easy to manage alerts across large multi-branch deployments.

title: Active Containers
content: This panel lists all active containers across your branches. You can filter by branch and click any container to view or edit its alert configuration.

title: Notification Settings
content: Use this settings icon to configure how alerts are delivered — choose Email, WhatsApp, or both. Click here to open Notification Settings.

title: Notification Channels
content: Toggle Email and WhatsApp to control which channels receive alert notifications. Changes take effect immediately after saving.

title: Close Settings
content: Close the Notification Settings panel to continue setting up your alert configuration.

title: Open Branch Dropdown
content: Click the Branch dropdown to see all available branches.

title: Select Bangalore
content: Click Bangalore to filter the container list to this branch.

title: Bangalore Containers
content: The list now shows containers in the Bangalore branch. Click on Container T-161 to load its alert configuration.

title: Alert Configuration Panel
content: This panel shows the full KPI alert setup for the selected container. Set minimum and maximum thresholds, choose critical or soft alert types, and control cooldown periods to avoid notification fatigue.

title: Internal Temperature
content: Internal Temperature is a Critical Alert — a breach triggers an email notification. Thresholds are set between -200°C and -180°C with a 30-minute cooldown to prevent repeated paging.

title: External Temperature
content: External Temperature uses a Soft Alert — you'll get an in-app notification without email. The safe range is 20°C to 30°C with a 30-minute cooldown.

title: LN2 Level
content: LN2 Level is a Critical Alert with email notifications. A minimum threshold of 22 kg is enforced with a 60-minute cooldown, giving the team time to respond before another alert fires.

title: Battery Level
content: Battery Level fires a Soft Alert (notification only) when charge drops below 20%. The 60-minute cooldown avoids a flood of low-battery notifications during a slow discharge.

title: Shock Detection
content: Shock Detection fires a Soft Alert when impact exceeds the configured G-force threshold — useful for flagging rough handling during transport.

title: Evaporation Rate
content: Evaporation Rate alerts when LN2 boils off faster than expected. We've set a Soft Alert with a range of 0.5–2.0 kg/hr and a 60-minute cooldown.

title: Lid State
content: Lid State is set to alert when the lid is opened unexpectedly. This catches accidental openings that could warm the container.

title: Save Alert Configuration
content: Click Save Changes to apply the new Evaporation Rate and Lid State alert settings for this container.

title: Configuration Saved
content: All KPI alerts are now configured for this container — Internal Temperature, External Temperature, LN2, Battery Level, Shock Detection, Evaporation Rate, and Lid State.
